title: Musical family: Gunsey Montgomery's band and ten siblings
summary: His great-uncle led a band; father, mother, brothers and sisters all played.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, I had a uncle, great uncle, my father's uncle. He had a band. His name was Gunsey Montgomery. He had the big four band out of Norleene, Louisiana.
Yeah. And what did he play?
Well, he played practically every instrument in the band.
That was a regular dance band then, was it?
Was it a Surnate band, dance band, like so forth. Yeah.
And you heard them then when you were?
Oh, around four or five years old, something like that.
Any of your other folks play or sing? Well, my father, he played carnet.
My mother, she played accordion. All my sisters were piano players and brothers also.
About how many brothers and sisters did you have?
It was ten in all, five girls and five boys. Yeah.
And they all played something then? It was really...
All played. My older brother, he played, uh, carnet, too. Mm-hmm. I used to play a bass tuba.
